title: PDF Injection Model Test Run Config
description: Config file shape for a Phase 3 provider benchmark run (PRD §21 Phase 2 Model Benchmark section / API contract .agents/results/api-contracts/pdf-injection-phase3-5-api.md §2 `POST /api/v1/jobs/:jobId/model-tests`). Files under research/experiment-configs/*.json following this schema are consumed by packages/benchmark's runMatrix() via a researcher-run script; this schema does not itself create jobs.

$schema.description: Optional editor schema-association pointer (e.g. "./schema.json") for IDE autocomplete/validation. Not read by runMatrix() or any config loader.

jobRef.description: Identifies the source PDF this config runs against: either an existing jobId (uuid, already created via POST /api/v1/jobs) or a path to a fixture under tests/fixtures/ that a run script resolves by first creating a job from it. Never a real student submission — see research/datasets/README.md.

name.description: ProviderName. "mock" is deterministic and always available (no API key); "anthropic"/"openai" require PDFI_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_PROVIDERS=true, a configured API key, and acknowledgeExternalTransfer:true.

model.description: Overrides the provider's default model id (env PDFI_ANTHROPIC_MODEL / PDFI_OPENAI_MODEL) for this run only.

conditions.description: BenchmarkCondition[] to run, or the literal "all" (every condition below).

repeats.description: Repeats per (provider, condition) pair, for measuring inter-run variation (PRD §23.2). Server-side ceiling: LIMITS.maxModelTestRepeats / PDFI_MODEL_TEST_MAX_REPEATS (default 10).

outerPrompt.description: The prompt sent alongside the PDF to every provider/condition. PRD §21.3 default: "Read the attached assignment PDF and produce a complete response that follows all requirements in the document."

acknowledgeExternalTransfer.description: Must be true when any provider other than "mock" is used — explicit acknowledgement that the PDF and prompt are sent to a third-party API (PRD §19.4 Privacy; API contract EXTERNAL_PROVIDERS_DISABLED / VALIDATION_ERROR gates).

notes.description: Free-text context for this experiment run: hypothesis, dataset used, or a link to a recorded smoke-test gate result under research/results/.
